notes.title: Hub and Visaul Overhaul
notes.content:
[h2][h1]Hub[/h1][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021743/0c1c03f0e284f9db75d92fb5861722268aed3cbb.png[/img]
Now when starting a game, instead of being shown a UI for choosing a level, players will  find themselves in a Hub. From this location, players can choose what chapter to start and also see their progress.
There is 4 possible paths for a player to choose. The difficulty of each chapter is represented by a number of black flags. Each chapter has its own representation of the progress made - total levels complete and quantity of stars collected.
The Hub also contains a switcher for difficulty that is located to the right of the spawn point and a switcher for enabling/disabling checkpoints to the left.
The Hub has its own musical track.
This addition should help the immersion.

[h2]Visual Overhaul[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021743/8accd52eb4716795589fcf0a36a46d43db5f2e7e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] All ground tiles have been redrawn from 16x16 to 24x24 with some additional tiles.
[*] Lighting has been improved.
[*] Increased water reflections resolution.
[*] UI visual improvements.
[*] Added helpful in-world hints for player input.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021743/a43d8754f79a32b2b5e2d52e5a7e30a4e97da5c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021743/419849910f25fbde7ab455590795da7284f0ac22.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021743/28704fdb8f81b98933f3d6bc4928d597f668f507.png[/img]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[*] Minor level design tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: New Difficulty: Doubt
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021743/93fd56c639fa9de97322cb51da5879113115f898.png[/img]
[h2]New difficulty "[b]Doubt[/b]" is added. [/h2]
[b]All levels turn pitch black[/b], you [b]hear [/b]a distant [b]familiar tone[/b], [b]it beckons[/b] you. 
Would you [b]take the challenge[/b] or [b]doubt your capabilities[/b]?
[list]
[*] Doubt every step!
[*] Say "Welcome" to the [b]indecision[/b], [b]hesitation [/b]and [b]lack of certainty[/b]!
[/list]
[h3]Welcome to the [b]"Doubt"[/b] difficulty![/h3]
